{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|All I seem to have left are responsibilities. Being a Matriarch means putting your own needs second.|Ranna Tao'Ven|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''matriarch''' was the leader of any specifically [[Gender/Legends|female]]-ruled culture. A prominent example of this was on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], where [[Zalem/Legends|Zalem]] was matriarch for a time.

During [[3643 BBY]], the illegal settlement [[Kalikori village|Kalikori Village]] had [[Sumari]] as matriarch, later being succeeded by her daughter [[Ranna Tao'Ven]] after her [[Death/Legends|death]].

[[Saheelindeel]] had a matriarch ruler during [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] visit, in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. On [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]], each clan had a matriarch, called ''[[Maitrakh]]''. This person was the storyteller, leader, and lore keeper of the clan. [[Bantha/Legends|Banthas]], [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], were very [[Sentience/Legends|intelligent]] and social [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] who lived in matriarchal herds.<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

The [[Devaron government]] was a matriarchy.<ref name="SEWED">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sagaenhancementdevaronians|text=Saga Edition Web Enhancement: Devaronians}}</ref>
